analysis.clock: Trace timestamps are monotonic microseconds; window boundaries come from renderer performance.mark, not wall-clock guesses.

presentationFeedback.interpretation: Renderer PipelineReporter presented-state termination timestamps and AnimationFrame::Presentation are Chromium presentation feedback. Browser-window FramePresented is reported separately and is not used as app presentation cadence.

pipelineReporter.interpretation: Raw renderer PipelineReporter states, not a deduplicated dropped-frame percentage. Forked/backfill reports can share a frame sequence.

frameSequenceTrackerV3Summaries.interpretation: Tracker-level cumulative expected/dropped counters. They can cover more than the selected window; do not sum overlapping tracker types.

stage.caveat: Per-event duration sums may overlap nested events; do not sum categories as total CPU time. Draw/swap cadence is not presented-frame cadence.
